name: The Ur-Sphinx
description: An alternate version of the Ur-Dragon in the Echoverse; a vain, godlike telepath whose blood and magic course through every sphinx.

description_citations.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The ur-sphinx is a powerful telepath second only to Jace.
relations.quote: the ur-sphinx is second only to Jace

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: The elder sphinx founders are its most favored creations.
relations.quote: It is said that the elder sphinx founders of Hexhaven are the Ur-Sphinx's most favored creations
